_merged_from_a_duplicate_under_another_n: apogee-electronics.json named the same maker differently and was deleted on 2026-11-25. One company: Apogee Electronics, which traded as Apogee Digital for part of its history and whose site is still apogeedigital.com. The three records under this brand carry « apogee », so that file survives - and its NAME is corrected to the current one, which is the one a reader will look for. The surviving name was changed from 'Apogee Digital' to 'Apogee Electronics'. Keys carried over: none, it held nothing new. Found by an extension of the duplicate-brand guard: the first version compared names EXACTLY and caught three pairs, then left three more because their names differ. The second version compares a NORMALISED name - parentheses dropped, and the words audio, electronics, technology, labs, systems, digital and a dozen others removed - and an exact repeat is an error while a normalised repeat is a warning, because the first is a certainty and the second a presumption. Measured when added: 3 collisions across 324 files, all 3 real.
